jobs.title: Customer Success Management Support
jobs.description:
About the job

We are excited to expand our Customer Success Department in The Hague with a new Customer Success Support colleague. We are looking for a proactive and hands-on data wizard who enjoys working with technology, structure, and deadlines.
As part of the team, you will support our Customer Success Managers and customers in creating smart and effective app solutions for events around the world.
A key part of this role will involve app submission-related tasks for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including preparing submission materials, coordinating the process, checking requirements, and following up on approvals or rejections.
Do you enjoy finding solutions, working accurately, and taking ownership? Are you passionate about technology and innovation? Then this is your opportunity to join a dynamic and international team that is helping shape the future of event apps.

About you

We are looking for a true multitasker with strong customer service and teamwork skills, combined with the confidence and organisational ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines. Experience with project management tools is appreciated. We believe in learning together, so we are primarily looking for a fast learner who can quickly adapt to new software and processes. You will need to work from our office at least twice a week.

In a nutshell, you are

Based within 30 km from The Hague
Passionate about data management
A problem-solving master: no problem is too small or too big
A proficient MS Excel user, preferably with HTML knowledge
Great at planning, timelines, and deadline management
Accurate and structured, with an eye for detail
Experienced in either the event industry, virtual platforms, or mobile apps
Skillful in written and verbal English communication and experienced talking to customers and stakeholders
Eager to show initiative and take ownership

NB: Please note we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, so candidates must already have the right to work in the EU.

What you'll be doing

Supporting our Customer Success Team and clients, both online and onsite
Preparing and submitting mobile apps to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store
Coordinating all app submission-related tasks, including preparing certificates and screenshots, checking submission requirements, managing timelines, and following up on approvals or rejections
Editing event data and importing it into mobile apps
Working on assignments across different project areas
Contributing to the development and improvement of new apps and internal processes

What does this position bring you?

An international work environment with a lot of fun thrown in!
International travel. Are you ready to support our clients onsite?
Flexible working hours
Unlimited holidays
Hybrid workspace with iMac setup both at home and in the office

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant
jobs.description:
We’re a game changer that optimizes supply chains of the world’s leading companies with our very own smart software and services.

Do you enjoy solving complex supply chain problems? Are you passionate about adding value to Fortune 500 companies? Do you have relevant experience and skills in the supply chain industry? Ready to join a place where smart solutions meet human collaboration?

If you answered yes, you might be the Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant we’re looking for.

Your challenge

As a Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant, you equip customers with supply chain planning solutions. You analyze planning challenges, assist in the solution design, implement and validate the solution, and ensure a smooth go-live. Customers rely on your support throughout the entire project life cycle.

You Are Responsible For

Finding clever planning solutions in collaboration with our solution architects to ensure an impeccable, high-quality implementation.
Implementing the solution from start to finish, together with the customer’s project team.
Providing expertise during and after implementation.
Training customers so they get the most of their solution.
Documenting the implemented solutions by providing technical descriptions to your fellow consultants and functional notes to the customer.

Although you’ll be visiting customers regularly (about 20% of your time), you won’t be outsourced. In this way you remain rooted in our team of experts and consultants.

Your team

As a Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant, you‘ll join the Delivery team as part of the Customer Solutions organization. The Delivery team delivers the solution and assists customers before, during, and beyond implementation. Once the global design is approved, all project team members join forces to implement all composing elements of the solution and provide flawless integration. User Engagement initiatives, training, documentation, and coaching enable customers to understand the solution and use it to its full potential.

About You

Essential talents and qualifications:

A Master's degree in Engineering (Business, Civil or Industrial) or Applied Sciences - relevant study domains are e.g. Business Informatics, Supply Chain/Logistics/Production, Chemical, Operations Research, Econometrics, Mathematics, ICT.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex problems into concrete solutions.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in supply chain in industry areas, management consulting, or software implementation consulting.
Knowledge of programming (Python, SQL, R, ...).
Overall, a strong affinity for IT as you need to be willing to learn an entirely new software package.
The flexibility to travel.
Fluent in English and German.
A passion for working in a multinational customer-driven environment.
A friendly and open approach to working in a team.

Your future

We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions.

Many of our team members who start as supply chain implementation consultants grow into the role of integration consultant, advisory consultant, customer application expert, solution architect, or project manager or grow into positions in business development or people management.

Our offer

At OMP, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

Continuous learning: Access customized training, coaching programs, and on-the-job development opportunities.
Flexibility: Flex your schedule with working from home, adaptable hours, and the autonomy to shape your routine.
Benefits: An attractive salary package including an optional company car, a bike incentive program, additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.
Collaborative culture: Cross-team collaboration and creative challenges that encourage you to share knowledge, celebrate wins, and grow together.
Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking.
Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.

Our Company

We’re a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1,400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world’s largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L’Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble.

Ready to be smart with heart? Join our team where technical expertise and human connection create solutions that scale globally and make a lasting impression.

Want to learn more? Visit careers.omp.com/life-at-omp.

jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Analyst, Residential Mortgage
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Regulatory Compliance Analyst is responsible for auditing and evaluating mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory, investor, and rating agency requirements. This role examines loan documentation against program guidelines, identifies and documents exceptions or deviations, and validates data discrepancies flagged by compliance analysts. Additional responsibilities include reviewing incoming trailing documents and client/seller rebuttals, managing workload assignments directed by a Team Lead, and meeting defined production standards.

Responsibilities

Ensure residential mortgage loan packages contain all necessary documentation required to formulate a complete assessment.
Gather regulatory compliance data elements from the loan file for capture in the due diligence review system.
Submit loan data to Mavent to perform regulatory compliance calculations.
Review and address compliance exceptions and failures identified from Mavent and determine validity of results by comparing input versus documentation error.
Validate all exceptions and update with the pertinent facts supporting the finding(s).
Confirm all data discrepancies and note the source document(s) and circumstance(s) when appending comments.
Work loan assignments based on the instructions from the project Team Lead/Business Analyst.
Adhere to minimum production requirements as communicated from the project Team Lead.
Monitor all communication channels (Outlook, Teams, Phone) for company updates/announcements and requests from your colleagues/Team Lead.

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years residential regulatory compliance experience.
Knowledge of TRID and RESPA LE/CD requirements.
Strong background in the use of computer programs used to review mortgage loans and standard knowledge of Microsoft Office product suite.
Ability to manage a pipeline of loan files
Demonstrate consistent attention to detail
Strong verbal & written communication skills

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT WAY

Way is building the AI, data, and infrastructure layer for the experience economy.

As artificial intelligence automates labor and people reclaim time, the shift toward spending on experiences over things only accelerates. Way sits at the center of that shift as the platform, intelligence layer, and curated marketplace on which experiences are created, distributed, and sold.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin with offices in Paris and San Francisco, Way built the category of experiences in hospitality from the ground up, during a pandemic that had shut the industry down. Leading global travel, retail, lifestyle, and hospitality brands leverage Way, including Hyatt, Hilton, Alaska Airlines, Aspen, Piaget, and countless others.

Way’s position is layered by design: a proprietary data network built on millions of experiential data points, the system of record for experiential operations, an e-commerce layer embedded directly into partners’ customer journeys, and a marketplace through Partner Exchange, where brands across hospitality, travel, lifestyle, and retail co-create and co-sell experiences with one another. Every brand that joins makes the network more valuable to every brand already on it.

That combination of data, workflow, distribution, and network effects is not something that can be vibe-coded into existence. It compounds. It is what positions Way as the durable infrastructure for the experience economy regardless of how the technology landscape evolves.

Way is backed with $22m in capital from Tiger Global and strategic family offices and angel investors. The company has mid-8 figures of ARR from a global enterprise customer set, with outstanding growth and efficiency metrics.

THE ROLE

Way is looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager who thrives in the complexity of scaling a startup. This role requires someone who is organized, analytical, an effective communicator, and strong at relationship building. You will own our largest customers, including relationships at the corporate and property level. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maximize Product Adoption:
Develop and execute strategic success plans at corporate and property levels, ensuring hotel brands fully leverage Way's product to meet their business objectives.
Manage Customer Sentiment:
Build and maintain customer relationships through proactive engagement, timely support, and broader relationship building.
Analyze & Act on Data:
Monitor account health weekly through usage patterns, revenue performance, and engagement metrics.
Lead Executive Business Reviews:
Prepare and deliver data-driven QBRs that demonstrate measurable value, identify growth opportunities, and align on strategic priorities with both customer and internal executive teams.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Coordinate internal resources across sales, product, marketing, and support teams to solve customer challenges, sharing insights that improve the overall customer experience and inform company strategy.
Maintain Strategic Account Plans:
Document organizational maps, stakeholder relationships, success metrics, and growth strategies for each account—keeping CRM and shared documentation current and accessible.
Navigate Complex Organizations:
Understand decision-making structures within hotel brands, ownership groups, and management companies to identify key influencers and drive adoption at all levels.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Growth Mindset:
You're energized by ambiguity, comfortable with change, and see fast-paced environments as opportunities rather than obstacles. You are looking to grow your abilities, intelligence, and skills through effort, learning, and persistence. 
Proactive Ownership:
You don't wait for problems to escalate or for customers to ask for help. You anticipate needs, surface risks early, and take initiative to drive outcomes. 
High Attention to Detail:
You catch what others miss—whether it's an inconsistency in customer data, a subtle shift in usage patterns, or a contract detail that matters for renewals. You take pride in accuracy, from the metrics in your QBRs to the forecasts you submit, knowing that small errors undermine credibility and trust.
Meticulous Organization:
You manage multiple accounts without dropping balls. Your documentation is current, your forecasts are accurate, and your teammates can find what they need without hunting you down.
Exceptional Communication Skills:
You adapt your message for different audiences and communicate with equal effectiveness in writing, presentations, and conversation. You're persuasive without being pushy, clear without being simplistic, and professional while remaining personable.
Business Acumen:
You understand how hotels make money, what drives their decisions, and how to position solutions that align with their objectives. You think commercially and can connect product features to customer outcomes and revenue impact.

WHY JOIN WAY?

Way is a company for people who want to do the best work of their careers at a technology company and in an industry that will continue to flourish as humanity embraces AI. The standard for building an exceptional software company has changed, and Way is being built to meet it, with urgency, ownership, and a pace of execution well above the industry norm. The market direction is not in question. As AI absorbs more and more work, humans have more time and more money to spend on experiences, and the brands they spend it with need infrastructure they cannot build themselves.

Compensation: competitive salary calibrated to experience, and meaningful equity in a sustainably growing company with real value creation already realized.
Coverage: full health, dental, and vision.
The work: direct access to the world’s most recognized consumer brands and the mandate to move quickly on their behalf.
The tools: the best available, and the expectation that you use them to raise your own ceiling.
Experience firsthand: an annual hotel and travel stipend at the properties and partners in Way’s global ecosystem.
Where you’ll be: in a beautiful office in Austin, San Francisco, or Paris.

new_jobs.description:
We’re a game changer that optimizes supply chains of the world’s leading companies with our very own smart software and services.

Do you enjoy solving complex supply chain problems? Are you passionate about adding value to Fortune 500 companies? Do you have relevant experience and skills in the supply chain industry? Ready to join a place where smart solutions meet human collaboration?

If you answered yes, you might be the Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant we’re looking for.

Your challenge

As a Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant, you equip customers with supply chain planning solutions. You analyze planning challenges, assist in the solution design, implement and validate the solution, and ensure a smooth go-live. Customers rely on your support throughout the entire project life cycle.

You Are Responsible For

Finding clever planning solutions in collaboration with our solution architects to ensure an impeccable, high-quality implementation.
Implementing the solution from start to finish, together with the customer’s project team.
Providing expertise during and after implementation.
Training customers so they get the most of their solution.
Documenting the implemented solutions by providing technical descriptions to your fellow consultants and functional notes to the customer.

Although you’ll be visiting customers regularly (about 20% of your time), you won’t be outsourced. In this way you remain rooted in our team of experts and consultants.

Your team

As a Senior Supply Chain Implementation Consultant, you‘ll join the Delivery team as part of the Customer Solutions organization. The Delivery team delivers the solution and assists customers before, during, and beyond implementation. Once the global design is approved, all project team members join forces to implement all composing elements of the solution and provide flawless integration. User Engagement initiatives, training, documentation, and coaching enable customers to understand the solution and use it to its full potential.

About You

Essential talents and qualifications:

A Master's degree in Engineering (Business, Civil or Industrial) or Applied Sciences - relevant study domains are e.g. Business Informatics, Supply Chain/Logistics/Production, Chemical, Operations Research, Econometrics, Mathematics, ICT.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex problems into concrete solutions.
Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in supply chain in industry areas, management consulting, or software implementation consulting.
Knowledge of programming (Python, SQL, R, ...).
Overall, a strong affinity for IT as you need to be willing to learn an entirely new software package.
The flexibility to travel.
Fluent in English and German.
A passion for working in a multinational customer-driven environment.
A friendly and open approach to working in a team.

Your future

We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions.

Many of our team members who start as supply chain implementation consultants grow into the role of integration consultant, advisory consultant, customer application expert, solution architect, or project manager or grow into positions in business development or people management.

Our offer

At OMP, we offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

Continuous learning: Access customized training, coaching programs, and on-the-job development opportunities.
Flexibility: Flex your schedule with working from home, adaptable hours, and the autonomy to shape your routine.
Benefits: An attractive salary package including an optional company car, a bike incentive program, additional extralegal vacation days, and other competitive benefits.
Collaborative culture: Cross-team collaboration and creative challenges that encourage you to share knowledge, celebrate wins, and grow together.
Innovation: Fuel innovation through collaboration, experimentation, and out of the box thinking.
Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.

Our Company

We’re a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1,400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world’s largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L’Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble.

Ready to be smart with heart? Join our team where technical expertise and human connection create solutions that scale globally and make a lasting impression.

Want to learn more? Visit careers.omp.com/life-at-omp.

new_jobs.title: Regulatory Compliance Analyst, Residential Mortgage
new_jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Regulatory Compliance Analyst is responsible for auditing and evaluating mortgage loan files to ensure accuracy and compliance with regulatory, investor, and rating agency requirements. This role examines loan documentation against program guidelines, identifies and documents exceptions or deviations, and validates data discrepancies flagged by compliance analysts. Additional responsibilities include reviewing incoming trailing documents and client/seller rebuttals, managing workload assignments directed by a Team Lead, and meeting defined production standards.

Responsibilities

Ensure residential mortgage loan packages contain all necessary documentation required to formulate a complete assessment.
Gather regulatory compliance data elements from the loan file for capture in the due diligence review system.
Submit loan data to Mavent to perform regulatory compliance calculations.
Review and address compliance exceptions and failures identified from Mavent and determine validity of results by comparing input versus documentation error.
Validate all exceptions and update with the pertinent facts supporting the finding(s).
Confirm all data discrepancies and note the source document(s) and circumstance(s) when appending comments.
Work loan assignments based on the instructions from the project Team Lead/Business Analyst.
Adhere to minimum production requirements as communicated from the project Team Lead.
Monitor all communication channels (Outlook, Teams, Phone) for company updates/announcements and requests from your colleagues/Team Lead.

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years residential regulatory compliance experience.
Knowledge of TRID and RESPA LE/CD requirements.
Strong background in the use of computer programs used to review mortgage loans and standard knowledge of Microsoft Office product suite.
Ability to manage a pipeline of loan files
Demonstrate consistent attention to detail
Strong verbal & written communication skills

Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

new_jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
ABOUT WAY

Way is building the AI, data, and infrastructure layer for the experience economy.

As artificial intelligence automates labor and people reclaim time, the shift toward spending on experiences over things only accelerates. Way sits at the center of that shift as the platform, intelligence layer, and curated marketplace on which experiences are created, distributed, and sold.

Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Austin with offices in Paris and San Francisco, Way built the category of experiences in hospitality from the ground up, during a pandemic that had shut the industry down. Leading global travel, retail, lifestyle, and hospitality brands leverage Way, including Hyatt, Hilton, Alaska Airlines, Aspen, Piaget, and countless others.

Way’s position is layered by design: a proprietary data network built on millions of experiential data points, the system of record for experiential operations, an e-commerce layer embedded directly into partners’ customer journeys, and a marketplace through Partner Exchange, where brands across hospitality, travel, lifestyle, and retail co-create and co-sell experiences with one another. Every brand that joins makes the network more valuable to every brand already on it.

That combination of data, workflow, distribution, and network effects is not something that can be vibe-coded into existence. It compounds. It is what positions Way as the durable infrastructure for the experience economy regardless of how the technology landscape evolves.

Way is backed with $22m in capital from Tiger Global and strategic family offices and angel investors. The company has mid-8 figures of ARR from a global enterprise customer set, with outstanding growth and efficiency metrics.

THE ROLE

Way is looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager who thrives in the complexity of scaling a startup. This role requires someone who is organized, analytical, an effective communicator, and strong at relationship building. You will own our largest customers, including relationships at the corporate and property level. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Maximize Product Adoption:
Develop and execute strategic success plans at corporate and property levels, ensuring hotel brands fully leverage Way's product to meet their business objectives.
Manage Customer Sentiment:
Build and maintain customer relationships through proactive engagement, timely support, and broader relationship building.
Analyze & Act on Data:
Monitor account health weekly through usage patterns, revenue performance, and engagement metrics.
Lead Executive Business Reviews:
Prepare and deliver data-driven QBRs that demonstrate measurable value, identify growth opportunities, and align on strategic priorities with both customer and internal executive teams.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally:
Coordinate internal resources across sales, product, marketing, and support teams to solve customer challenges, sharing insights that improve the overall customer experience and inform company strategy.
Maintain Strategic Account Plans:
Document organizational maps, stakeholder relationships, success metrics, and growth strategies for each account—keeping CRM and shared documentation current and accessible.
Navigate Complex Organizations:
Understand decision-making structures within hotel brands, ownership groups, and management companies to identify key influencers and drive adoption at all levels.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Growth Mindset:
You're energized by ambiguity, comfortable with change, and see fast-paced environments as opportunities rather than obstacles. You are looking to grow your abilities, intelligence, and skills through effort, learning, and persistence. 
Proactive Ownership:
You don't wait for problems to escalate or for customers to ask for help. You anticipate needs, surface risks early, and take initiative to drive outcomes. 
High Attention to Detail:
You catch what others miss—whether it's an inconsistency in customer data, a subtle shift in usage patterns, or a contract detail that matters for renewals. You take pride in accuracy, from the metrics in your QBRs to the forecasts you submit, knowing that small errors undermine credibility and trust.
Meticulous Organization:
You manage multiple accounts without dropping balls. Your documentation is current, your forecasts are accurate, and your teammates can find what they need without hunting you down.
Exceptional Communication Skills:
You adapt your message for different audiences and communicate with equal effectiveness in writing, presentations, and conversation. You're persuasive without being pushy, clear without being simplistic, and professional while remaining personable.
Business Acumen:
You understand how hotels make money, what drives their decisions, and how to position solutions that align with their objectives. You think commercially and can connect product features to customer outcomes and revenue impact.

WHY JOIN WAY?

Way is a company for people who want to do the best work of their careers at a technology company and in an industry that will continue to flourish as humanity embraces AI. The standard for building an exceptional software company has changed, and Way is being built to meet it, with urgency, ownership, and a pace of execution well above the industry norm. The market direction is not in question. As AI absorbs more and more work, humans have more time and more money to spend on experiences, and the brands they spend it with need infrastructure they cannot build themselves.

Compensation: competitive salary calibrated to experience, and meaningful equity in a sustainably growing company with real value creation already realized.
Coverage: full health, dental, and vision.
The work: direct access to the world’s most recognized consumer brands and the mandate to move quickly on their behalf.
The tools: the best available, and the expectation that you use them to raise your own ceiling.
Experience firsthand: an annual hotel and travel stipend at the properties and partners in Way’s global ecosystem.
Where you’ll be: in a beautiful office in Austin, San Francisco, or Paris.
